_comment: RP plugin guidance-nudge rows. Schema and gate semantics: see plugins/session/hooks/nudges/rules.json. Rows here are merged by nudge-engine.sh alongside every other plugin's rules.json and the ~/.asha/nudges.json user layer (later wins by id). A relative inject_file resolves against THIS plugin's hooks/nudges/ directory.

rules.match_regex: escap(e|ing)|get(ting)? out|way out|leav(e|ing) the|exit|entrance|entry point|break in|sever(ing)?|close off|cut off|permanent(ly)?|forever|irreversib|undo|resurrect|revive|bring .* back|come back|banish|dispel|the price|what it costs|what does it cost|at what cost|bargain|pact|toll|reset
rules._comment: Fires when a turn's text touches a class of thing settings typically price: exits and entrances, permanence and reversal, resurrection, banishment, bargains. Diagnosed 2026-07-26 (Darkest House): a GM adjudicated how a character leaves the house and invented a costless exit without ever opening the Source Rules Reference, which lists six escape methods, closed, each priced. That diagnosis is provenance only — the regex is deliberately setting-agnostic and MUST stay that way: proper nouns from one campaign (a specific NPC, door, or location) in a shipped rule fire on that campaign's vocabulary and stay silent in every other project, which is the opposite of the intent. Projects add their own trigger vocabulary by redefining this row in ~/.asha/nudges.json (merged by id, user wins). Payload is a POINTER plus a protocol duty, not injected content — the register stays in the project, and content injection would cost context on every fire. Marker-gated so it is inert outside RP; 1h cooldown so a stake-heavy scene does not nag. Kill switch: Work/markers/nudge-rp-priced-stakes-off (generic) or rp-priced-stakes-off (marker_off).
